title: Dark's simple QoL
description: Simple lightweight modpack with optimization and some QoL mods
body:
# Hello! Welcome to my modpack.
This modpack adds optimization and some QoL mods. It's lightweight and simple! I'll upload versions without my configs. I don't think it'll be updated regulary. Any new version of MC will have different mods. (but some mods will stay!)
### List of mods that always stays in modpack:
- Xaero's Minimap and Worldmap
- AppleSkin
- Carpet mod and addons
- Chat animations (any mod for this)
- Held Item info
- Any zoom mod
- JEI (or other mod for recipes)
- Litematica
- TotemCounter
- uku's Armor HUD
- Jade
